senses.gloss: उद्-ऋ॑च् क्, f. remainder, conclusion, end, VS.; TS.; ŚBr.; ĀśvŚr. &c.
उद्-ऋ॑चि ind. lastly, at last, finally, RV. i, 53, 11; x, 77, 7; AV. vi, 48, 1; 2; 3.

उद्-√ ऋ P. -इयर्ति (pf. 2. sg. -आ॑रिथा, RV. ii, 9, 3; aor. -आरत्, RV. iv, 58, 1) Ā. (aor. -आर्त, RV. vii, 35, 7)
to start up, rise, come up;
to move up, raise, excite, RV. i, 113, 17; iii, 8, 5, &c. :
Caus. -अर्पयति, to cause to rise or prosper, RV. ii, 33, 4; KātyŚr.
उद्-√ 2. ऋष् P. (p. -ऋष॑त्) to perforate, pierce, RV. x, 155, 2.
उद्-√ दृश् See उत्-पश्, p. 181, col. 1.
उद्-√ दृंह् P. (Impv. 2. sg. उ॑द्-दृंह) to erect and fortify, VS. xvii, 72.
उ॑द्-दृष्ट n. the appearance or becoming visible of the moon, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; TBr.; TāṇḍyaBr.
